instruction: Please export the "Meeting-Agenda.docx" file from the Desktop to PDF format and save it to the meetings folder in Google Drive.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting Meeting-Agenda.docx to PDF and uploading to Google Drive. Evaluator checks if the PDF is readable (can be opened and parsed without errors).
metadata.verification: Simple readability check - verifies that the PDF was properly generated and can be opened without corruption.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only verifies that SOME readable PDF exists at the target path, but does not verify it was converted from Meeting-Agenda.docx
No content validation - any PDF uploaded to meetings/Meeting-Agenda.pdf would pass, even if not converted from the original document
Missing verification that the conversion operation actually occurred (vs. manual PDF upload)
The getter and metric logic are correct for what they check (file existence and readability), but this is insufficient for the full instruction
The task requires both conversion (DOCX to PDF) AND upload, but evaluator only checks the upload result
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add content validation: extract text from both the original DOCX and resulting PDF to verify content similarity
Add file metadata check: verify creation/modification timestamps to ensure PDF was recently created
Add file size validation: verify PDF size is reasonable compared to DOCX size
Consider checking PDF properties (creator, producer) to verify it was generated by LibreOffice/conversion tool
Alternative: if content validation is too complex, at minimum verify the PDF has multiple pages and contains text (not just an empty PDF)
